Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Identifies the currency used for the benchmark curve.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Identifies the name of the benchmark curve.

Point.name: Point
Point.definition: Identifies a point on a benchmark curve. The point can be stated via a combination of maturity month/year and coupon.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Spread for which a benchmark curve is specified.
